title: unified-rollouts-proactive-canary-shadow-autorollback-workflow
author: Priya Singh
description: Motivation: reduce blast radius for model rollouts by adding a proactive canary+shadow rollout workflow that automatically quarantines and rolls back variants based on multi-metric thresholds and quarantine probing. This PR implements the orchestration pieces, observability hooks, and e2e stability guards required to operate proactive auto-rollback across hosted/dedicated/private deployments. Key features: 1) new rollout controller phases: probe -> quarantine -> scaled-canary -> promote/rollback; 2) shadow traffic probing with sampled golden requests and synthetic canary probes; 3) composite metric evaluation engine (latency p95, error-rate, perplexity delta, semantic drift) with quorum rules; 4) quarantine stage that isolates suspect variants and runs targeted probes before full rollback; 5) integration with observability to emit rollout.trace_id, per-variant metrics and rollback reasons; 6) e2e tests and stability guards to prevent flapping and ensure deterministic backoff. Checklist: - [x] rollout controller implementation - [x] metric evaluator with quorum and weight rules - [x] shadow traffic probe runner - [x] quarantine state and manual override hooks - [x] telemetry and dashboards (metrics/events/traces) - [x] unit + integration tests - [x] e2e stability tests in perf-canary harness - [x] docs and API surface updates. Backwards compatibility: new workflow is additive; existing rollout configs remain supported by default. Rollout config examples and docs included in redwood-docs. Linear: ENG-1245, ENG-1301; Jira: SUP-4312.
